rationale: The dataset label denotes a general anatomical landmark. Accept only the explicitly named structure in the body-structure domain, without asserting visualization of the whole organ or substituting a neighboring structure. Exact means the scoped anatomical class meaning, not image revalidation. Entire/part qualifiers are not removed or inferred. The major papilla remains a separate related MST landmark and cannot become an exact synonym of the internal ampulla.
